response.rationale: The item is electronics with days_since_delivery of 33, exceeding the 15-day electronics window. RET-003 applies (priority 20), which controls over the standard-window rules (priority 10). No higher-priority exceptions apply: not final_sale (RET-012), not defective (RET-020), no goodwill grant (RET-050), and no fraud hold. Customer loyalty framing does not affect eligibility.
